title: Etale finite models imply intrinsic fixed-coefficient pro-etale models
statement: Under the hypotheses of finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding, the displayed etale-local property P(F) implies IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule for the inverse image of the fixed-scalar slice restriction of F under proEtaleModuleEncoding.

source.place: Tag 099Y, etale charts are pro-etale charts and pull back along pro-etale objects

proof.text: Use the identity etale chart, regard each etale covering sieve as a pro-etale covering, and pull it back along every pro-etale object. Transport the displayed ringed-slice models through scalar restriction, localization, and normalized constant-module comparisons; the result is a finitely presented fixed-coefficient model on each pro-etale cover member.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding_forward_bridge
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ) (V : X.Etale)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R
    let P : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀) := fun F ↦
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ)).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                        (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                      koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
    P F → IsFinitelyPresentedLocallyConstantProEtaleModule
      ((proEtaleModuleEncoding V.left B).inverse.obj
        ((finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R φ V).obj F))
